claims.statement: The local pretraining entrypoint learns binary shape or pitch targets from scene/tone inputs, updates encoder and classifier only with --train, and reports train versus dry-run explicitly.
claims.location: course/training.md:T.6 opening and encoder commands, lines 256-265
claims.scope: Contract and one-step parameter update only; no claim that either full 300-step recipe passes its gate or learns real images/speech.

evidence.supports: binary labels, pooled encoder features, cross entropy/backward, conditional optimizer.step and save, mode report
pixel/waveform inputs and feature encoders
step performs updates for parameters with gradients

verification.expected: Dry run has no changed encoder tensors or saves; one train step changes encoder tensors and saves.
verification.observed: Both modalities: dry-run changed 0, train changed vision 7/audio 6 encoder parameter tensors; mode and save_calls match flags.
verification.details: /pretrain_runs, 4 original main calls with steps=1, cpu; torch.save intercepted to record payload, no weights retained.

claims.statement: Each encoder report has 2 holdout examples; square/circle labels are 0/1 and audio 180/1000 Hz are low/high 0/1; accuracy 0.5 is one of two and 1 is two of two.
claims.location: course/training.md:T.6 paragraph after encoder commands, line 265
claims.scope: Finite synthetic holdout denominator, conditional go/no-go gate; no trained quality measurement asserted in T.6.

evidence.supports: exact holdout rules, labels, mean accuracy denominator

verification.expected: Vision16 train/2 holdout, audio4 train/2 holdout, labels [0,1]; 1/2=0.5 and 2/2=1.
verification.observed: Original AST item construction and four entrypoint reports match these counts; independent divisions yield 0.5 and 1.0.
verification.details: /pretrain_partition; /pretrain_runs/*/report. Original item assignment executed, raw held attributes recorded, exact tensor overlap=0.
verification.tolerance: Integer counts and half fractions exact; no rounding needed.

claims.statement: The vision holdout consists of two pictures at a new position (original wording: 視覺留出兩張新位置圖).
claims.location: course/training.md:T.6 line 265, 視覺留出兩張新位置圖
claims.scope: Whether the holdout position itself is absent from training.

evidence.supports: holdout is blue AND offset==1; all other colors at offset==1 remain training

verification.details: /pretrain_partition/vision/{holdout_raw_attributes,training_offsets,training_at_holdout_offset}; exact held tensor inputs are distinct, but position is not unseen.

issues.quote: 視覺留出兩張新位置圖
issues.finding: Position offset1 appears in four training images; only blue+offset1 is unseen. This wording can mistake a held color-position combination for a held position.
issues.impact: Misstates the holdout split and what the two examples test.
issues.recommendation: Say blue, offset=1 square/circle are held out, while red/green at the same offset are in training; describe an unseen color-position combination or new images, not an unseen position.
issues.resolution: Awaiting coordinator text correction and this reviewer's personal reinspection.

factual_accuracy.details: One concrete held-position wording error remains; other operational claims verified with original methods and bounded CPU evidence.

numeric_verification.details: Personally recomputed holdout labels/counts and 1/2,2/2; checked16kHz units and1600 samples/0.1s. No existing training-performance numbers are asserted in T.6.

figure_consistency.details: T.6 has no embedded image/SVG/caption or spatial diagram to compare. Task/class/axis mapping is fully stated in text/commands; no section figure was rendered because none exists.

source_verification.details: Personally read original methods after AST定位 and exact matching-version official PyTorch/SoundFile/Pillow HTTPS originals at named passages; no old technical/reader conclusion read.

limitations.details: Bash recipes audited, not run to300/500 steps orCUDA. Expected circle/high/square,low are targets, not measured trained outputs. No download, GPU, new capability score, retained weights or engineering change. Short CPU diagnostics and controlled scoring do not establish real image/speech/retention quality.
